draft_text: Thornbill-NER appears somewhat robust to label noise in its training annotations.
rationale: The package contains no label-noise experiments. All results (T1) are on original training labels; no perturbation condition, no noise-aware comparison, and no robustness criterion is applied. The claim about robustness to label noise has no support, and no narrower defensible version remains.
